hypotheses.D0_adjoint_decomposition_is_exact: CE write gradients equal prediction-minus-target gradients and all forward-adjoint contractions agree with direct write contractions to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.D1_target_readout_dominates_ce_energy: Target-logit effect energy is at least prediction-term effect energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_prediction_term_has_compact_forward_i: The discovery-frozen rank-64 forward basis retains at least 0.90 of the probability-weighted prediction effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_target_term_is_broad_at_rank64: The rank-64 forward basis retains less than 0.90 of the target-logit effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_model_margin_has_compact_forward_inte: The rank-64 forward basis retains at least 0.90 of the model-chosen top1-versus-runner-up margin effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.D5_target_adjoint_is_broader_than_predic: Discovery effective-adjoint R90 for the target term exceeds prediction-term R90 by at least 32.
hypotheses.D6_target_identity_predicts_repeated_tar: Leave-one-out target-token prototypes retain at least 0.50 of target-term effects on discovery sites whose token occurs at least twice.
hypotheses.D7_target_identity_clusters_effective_ad: Mean same-token effective-adjoint cosine exceeds a matched different-token mean by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.D8_ce_breadth_is_primarily_target_readou: At rank 64, the prediction term exceeds CE fidelity by at least 0.10 and target-term fidelity is within 0.05 of CE on every corpus.
hypotheses.D9_target_prototypes_transfer_across_con: On every corpus, at least 25% of sites have a target token seen in discovery and frozen token prototypes retain at least 0.50 on those covered sites.
